text:
1
A sugar cube is dropped into a hot cup of tea.
The tea is not stirred.
Which statement explains why the tea becomes sweet?
A
The heated water molecules penetrate the sugar cube.
B
The hot tea causes the sugar to melt.
C
The sugar cube dissolves and its molecules diffuse.
D
The sugar molecules get hot and evaporate.

options.label: A
options.text: The heated water molecules penetrate the sugar cube.

options.label: B
options.text: The hot tea causes the sugar to melt.

options.label: C
options.text: The sugar cube dissolves and its molecules diffuse.

options.label: D
options.text: The sugar molecules get hot and evaporate.
